第七章 风雨欲来
众人都过来给郭飞见礼，在郭飞看来，老二是个精明人，一脸书生相，对郭飞很亲热，但“假”的成分很多；老八和老九有点憨厚，待人很实诚；其余人都很冷淡，淡淡的打个招呼就回到自己的铺位休息了。
通过和他们聊天，郭飞知道，这个兵营是个杂牌军，当兵的五花八门，大部分不是为了保家卫国的，而是为了赚钱。有雇佣兵的意味。
比如，这个小队中八人根本不是赵国人，而是来自北原卫国，距离这里有几万公里的一个王国。他们来这里就是为了获得魂晶，赚一笔钱回家。
只有老九是赵国人，众人问郭飞，郭飞也说自己是赵国人。老九一听，顿时和郭飞亲近了很多。老九岁数不大，也就十六岁左右，个子也不高，一米七五左右，但体格剽悍，皮肤黝黑，看起来有一股爆发力，如同一只豹子，使用两把一米长的短柄斧头。
下午，金大通带着十人去了练兵场，操练十人攻防队型。郭飞对这种队形攻杀还是第一次接触，他们的队形虽然很简单，但是很实用，郭飞很感兴趣。
兵营不常组织大规模集体操练，只是每月一次比斗，通过挑战的方式，从中选出百夫中队长、十人小队长。这种方式倒是刺激了不少人，都私下暗自用劲。
千夫大队长以上的职务都由军团指派，营长王志有一千精锐禁卫队，那是他的嫡系，也是整个军营战斗力最强的大队。
“原来也是炮灰营！”郭飞了解后，不禁有所失望。兵营讲究的是整体作战，但这样的兵营完全是自主散漫的训练，一看就不是什么正规军。
另外，从他们聊天中，郭飞了解了很多知识，比如现在所在的大陆称之为浩渺大陆，大陆共有五个部分：北原、中州、南荒、西域、东海。
每个区域都异常的广大，他们也只是道听途说，以他们的阅历，也就在附近几个小国走动。只有那种能飞天遁地的高级修士才可能游历整个大陆。
这是个神魔的世界，不但有人族，而且还有灵族、妖族、魔族、鬼族。从他们口中发现，灵族是人族的守护者。妖族、鬼族和人族互有征伐。魔族诡异异常，是灵族和人族的死敌。谈起的时候都有所色变。
郭飞最关心修炼的问题，但这些人也不了解，只知道人族修炼凝聚五行真气。修士走武者和术士两种修炼之路。最低的为武者和术士，高一级的称为气修士和术师，气修士能发出无形真气，营长王志就是低级气修士。
术士是极为神秘，从他们口中探听不出来有价值的东西。
其它族修士的划分，和人族又有不同。比如鬼族，低级的为鬼兵，高一级的为鬼卫，其上还有鬼将、鬼王等。他们也一知半解，因为和鬼族作战，军部才派人普及了这些知识，其它族的他们根本不知道。
郭飞虽然很感兴趣，但他们所知有限。不过，从他们的口中郭飞知道，如果立有大功，成为王国的贵族或者在籍军官，王国会根据其身体五行属性，赐予修炼的功法或者高等级的兵器。每个帝国、王国、公国都是靠这来招揽人才的，所以，修炼的功法都是不传之谜，无比珍贵。
这些，正是这些人动力所在。
“这个世界真是复杂、危险和刺激呀！”郭飞了解后，感到有压力的同时，更是充满了期待。自己变异的兵符，恐怕不但可以培养厉害的兵种，更是修炼的法门。体内的热流恐怕就是修炼之路。
“杀人，取得经验升级才是王道！”郭飞沉思着。
鬼族的通牒，很快就引起了赵王国上层的重视，十天时间，黑壁防线增加了大量的兵马。偶尔，天空中还划过一道亮丽的光芒。每当这个时候，营长王志都会矗立在营房院落中仰视，眼中露出了一丝艳羡的光芒。

郭飞透着营房的窗户看向天空，并从营长的眼神中发现了丝丝端倪。心中暗自揣度，营长肯定知道这些光芒的来源，毕竟他达到了气修士级别，踏入了五行真气修炼的门槛，比金大通这个武者强多了。
郭飞很想去找营长讨教一番，毕竟这个世界的武技，郭飞太想知道了，文叔哪里不好细问，每次扯起这个话题，他都异常的失落，让郭飞不好往下追问。
现在让郭飞最上心的是，自己兵符赋予自己的技能在这个世界有多大威力，能否让自己立足。郭飞冥冥中感到，兵符进入这个空间后，被这个空间改造了，产生了一丝变异。
对于自己安身立命的兵符，郭飞不得不仔细的推敲其中隐藏的机密。最稳妥的办法就是学习这个世界的武技，并且和自己兵符技能印证。
在郭飞进入兵营十天后，他们的营也被拉上了黑壁城墙，此时，在这个地方聚集了百万兵马，定国公封地的八十万兵马加上赵王派来的六十万兵马全部集中在这里。
在冰天雪地里，刀剑如林、战旗似海，一片肃杀的景象。步兵营全部在黑壁城墙上守卫，弓箭兵营交叉分布在步兵营中间，骑兵营全部列队在黑壁城墙外通道附近待命。
按建制、分兵种，各自履行自己的任务，一切忙碌而不混乱，调兵遣将也井然有序。让郭飞大为惊叹。金大通不厌其烦的给郭飞讲兵营打仗的规矩，生怕他触犯了纪律，在这里触犯了纪律，很可能被立马砍头。
来到这个世界，先是文叔救了自己的命；接着是金大通热心的带领自己，虽然他有目的，但郭飞从他的话语中感到了浓浓的关心，这个粗犷的汉子是个坦率正直的人。这两个人的关怀让郭飞在这个等级森严、冰冷的环境中感到了一丝温馨。
这个世界人口多，打仗阵势浩大。一个小小的赵王国就有几亿人口，地域宽阔无比，调用百万兵马算不上大规模的战役。让郭飞惊讶的是，这样的王国在北原竟然不知道有多少个。
王国、公国不断的更换似乎是常事，就如同日出日落一样的优胜劣汰。但，在北原，帝国只有三个。因为，统治北原人族的灵族姜家规定，帝国只能有三个。
要想建立帝国，就要挑战其中的一个帝国，并征得灵族姜家的同意，将其灭掉，取而代之。而且成为帝国似乎还要有条件。
不过，听金大通等人的议论，他们也知之不多。但，通过他们的谈话，郭飞还是了解到，在北原，每个帝、王、公都不是徒有其爵位的，他们的修为和其地位基本上都是相衬的。不然，根本守不住自己的家业。
“这个世界是个让人奋进，以力牟利的残酷世界。”郭飞听到这样的信息，感到一阵的热血沸腾。同时，对灵族产生了浓厚的兴趣，在北原，一个家族竟然有这么大的威势，统治这么多人族，到底具有何种神力。

Chapter 7 The storm is coming
Everyone came to greet Guo Fei. In Guo Fei's opinion, the second child was a shrewd man, with a bookish look on his face, and he was very affectionate towards Guo Fei, but there were many "fake" elements; the eighth and ninth children were a bit honest and honest in their treatment of others; the rest of the people were very cold, saying hello lightly and went back to their bunks to rest.
By chatting with them, Guo Fei knew that this barracks was a mixed army with all kinds of soldiers. Most of them were not there to protect their families and country, but to make money. It's like a mercenary.
For example, the eight people in this team are not from Zhao at all, but from Beiyuan Weiguo, a kingdom tens of thousands of kilometers away from here. They come here just to get soul crystals and make some money to go home.
Only Lao Jiu is from Zhao. Everyone asked Guo Fei, and Guo Fei also said that he was from Zhao. When Lao Jiu heard this, he immediately became much closer to Guo Fei. Lao Jiu is not old, about sixteen years old, and he is not tall, about 1.75 meters tall, but he has a strong physique, dark skin, and looks to be explosive, like a leopard, using two one-meter-long short-handled axes.
In the afternoon, Jin Datong took ten people to the training ground to practice the ten-man offensive and defensive formations. This was Guo Fei's first contact with this kind of formation for attacking and killing. Although their formation was very simple, it was very practical, and Guo Fei was very interested.
The barracks do not often organize large-scale collective drills, but only compete once a month, and through challenges, a centurion squadron leader and a ten-man squad leader are selected. This method actually stimulated many people, and they all tried their best in private.
Positions above the captain level are assigned by the legion. Battalion Commander Wang Zhi has a thousand elite guards, which are his direct lineage and the most powerful group in the entire military camp.
"It turns out it's also a cannon fodder camp!" Guo Fei couldn't help but feel disappointed after learning about it. The emphasis in the barracks is on overall combat, but such a barracks is completely independent and unorganized training, and it is not a regular army at first glance.
In addition, from their chat, Guo Fei learned a lot of knowledge. For example, the continent he is currently on is called the Vast Continent. There are five parts of the continent: Beiyuan, Zhongzhou, Southern Wasteland, Western Regions, and East China Sea.
Each area is extremely vast, and they only heard about it through hearsay. Based on their experience, they only traveled around a few small countries nearby. Only high-level monks who can fly into the sky and escape from the earth can travel across the entire continent.
This is a world of gods and demons, not only humans, but also spirits, monsters, demons, and ghosts. It was discovered from their mouths that the Eldar are the guardians of the human race. The demon clan, ghost clan and human clan conquered each other. The demons are strange and abnormal, and are the mortal enemies of the spirits and humans. Everyone's expression changes when they talk about it.
Guo Fei is most concerned about the issue of cultivation, but these people don't understand either. They only know that human cultivation condenses the five elements of true energy. Monks follow two paths of cultivation: warrior and warlock. The lowest ones are warriors and warlocks, and the higher ones are called qi monks and magicians. The qi monks can emit invisible Qi. The battalion commander Wang Zhi is a low-level qi monk.
Warlocks are extremely mysterious, and nothing valuable can be gleaned from them.
The divisions of monks from other races are different from those of the human race. For example, in the ghost clan, the lower level ones are ghost soldiers, the higher level ones are ghost guards, and above them there are ghost generals, ghost kings, etc. They also knew little about it. Because of the war with the ghost clan, the military sent people to popularize this knowledge. They didn't know it at all from other clans.
Although Guo Fei was very interested, their knowledge was limited. However, Guo Fei knew from what they said that if he made great achievements and became a noble or an officer of the kingdom, the kingdom would grant him the skills to practice or high-level weapons based on the five elements of his body. Every empire, kingdom, and principality relies on this to recruit talents, so the skills they practice are mysteries that have not been passed down and are extremely precious.
These are what motivate these people.
"This world is really complex, dangerous and exciting!" After Guo Fei learned about it, he felt pressured and full of expectations. Change yourselfDifferent weapon talismans may not only cultivate powerful soldiers, but also become a method of training. The heat in the body is probably the path to cultivation.
"Killing people, gaining experience and upgrading is the way to go!" Guo Fei pondered.
The ghost clan's ultimatum quickly attracted the attention of the upper echelons of the Zhao Kingdom. Within ten days, a large number of troops and horses were added to the Black Wall defense line. Occasionally, a bright light flashed across the sky. At this time, battalion commander Wang Zhi would stand in the courtyard of the barracks and look up, with a glimmer of envy in his eyes.
Guo Fei looked at the sky through the window of the barracks, and found some clues in the battalion commander's eyes. He secretly speculated in his heart that the battalion commander must know the source of these lights. After all, he has reached the level of Qi monk and has stepped into the threshold of Five Elements Qi cultivation. He is much stronger than the warrior Jin Datong.
Guo Fei really wanted to go to the battalion commander for advice. After all, Guo Fei really wanted to know about the martial arts in this world. Uncle Wen couldn't ask more about it. Every time this topic was brought up, he felt unusually disappointed, which made it difficult for Guo Fei to ask further questions.
What worries Guo Fei most now is how powerful the skills given to him by his military talisman are in this world, and whether they can give him a foothold. Guo Fei vaguely felt that after entering this space, the soldier talisman was transformed by this space, causing a slight mutation.
Guo Fei had to carefully examine the secrets hidden in the military talisman where he settled down. The safest way is to learn the martial arts of this world and verify it with your own weapon skills.
Ten days after Guo Fei entered the barracks, their camp was also pulled up to the black wall. At this time, millions of soldiers and horses gathered in this place, including 800,000 soldiers and horses from Dingguogong's fiefdom and 600,000 soldiers and horses sent by King Zhao. All gathered here.
In the ice and snow, swords are like a forest and battle flags are like the sea, creating a chilling scene. All the infantry battalions were guarding on the Heibi City Wall, the archer battalions were crisscrossed in the middle of the infantry battalions, and the cavalry battalions were all lined up and on standby near the passage outside the Heibi City Wall.
According to the organization and division of arms, each performs its own tasks. Everything is busy but not chaotic, and the deployment of troops and generals is also in order. Guo Fei was greatly amazed. Jin Datong took the trouble to explain to Guo Fei the rules of fighting in the barracks, for fear that he would violate the rules. If he violated the rules here, he might be beheaded immediately.
When he came to this world, Uncle Wen first saved his life; then Jin Datong enthusiastically led him. Although he had a purpose, Guo Fei felt deep concern from his words. This rough man was a frank and upright person. The care of these two people made Guo Fei feel a little warm in this hierarchical and cold environment.
This world has a large population and huge war formations. The small Kingdom of Zhao has a population of hundreds of millions and a vast territory. It cannot be considered a large-scale battle with millions of soldiers and horses. What surprised Guo Fei was that there were countless such kingdoms in Beiyuan.
The constant replacement of kingdoms and principalities seems to be a common thing, just like the sunrise and sunset, the survival of the fittest. However, in Beiyuan, there are only three empires. Because, the Jiang family of the spirit clan that rules the Northern Plains human race stipulates that there can only be three empires.
If you want to establish an empire, you must challenge one of the empires and obtain the consent of the Jiang family of the Spirit Tribe to destroy it and replace it. And it seems there are conditions for becoming an empire.
However, listening to the discussions of Jin Datong and others, they didn’t know much. However, through their conversation, Guo Fei learned that in Beiyuan, every emperor, king, and duke did not just have their title, and their cultivation basically matched their status. Otherwise, you will not be able to keep your family business at all.
"This world is a cruel world where people strive for progress and use their strength to make profits." Guo Fei felt his blood boiling when he heard this information. At the same time, he developed a strong interest in the spirit race. In Beiyuan, a family has such great power and rules so many races. What kind of divine power does it have.
